documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting For The Quarter Ended On 30Th June 2026
Un-Audited Financials Results For The Quarter Ended On 30Th June 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited released its Q1FY27 investor presentation highlighting financial performance, operational parameters, and a corporate restructuring scheme involving the amalgamation of Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited and demerger of the independent copper business into Tieramet Ltd. Management reported growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT alongside a preferential issue of Rs. 52.25 Crores. The company outlines strategic priorities focused on value-added copper solutions, sustainability, capacity expansion, and digital transformation. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported record financial performance for FY26, crossing Rs.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR in turnover for the next 3 to 4 years to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
guidance.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR. 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% minimum every year.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices. Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

demand_outlook.claim: Sourcing of copper scrap from the Gulf has dried up due to diverted shipping lines, affecting the broader industry.
demand_outlook.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to double to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the overall copper demand in India has witnessed significant growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The overall copper demand in India has witnessed significant growth

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have, proposed 40 crores capex in the last, in the next 2 years. I think somehow that slide must have been missed out. We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed manufacturing capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated a projected FY27E Capex of INR 25 Cr.

margins_costs.claim: New silver and tin-coated bus bar products for AI data centers are expected to give roughly 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins. And this go for AI data centers and other data centers all over the world.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: The company supplies to over 500 clients with enduring relationships of over 30 years.
orders_capacity.quote: We have 500-plus clients with enduring relationships of over 30 years. Anchored in quality, integrity, and service.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores, which management stated is proportional to revenue.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores. And this increase in working capital is proportional to our revenue, so there's no, no reason to be concerned.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reach 5,000 crores in revenue in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR.

management_commitments.claim: Management proposed 40 crores capex in the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have, proposed 40 crores capex in the last, in the next 2 years. I think somehow that slide must have been missed out. We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management is planning to raise approximately 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

management_commitments.claim: Lead recycling plans have been dropped for at least the next one to one and a half years.
management_commitments.quote: Lead recycling, for the time being, we have dropped it. At least for the next one, one and a half years, we are not looking at lead.

management_commitments.claim: The company planned a Capex of INR 25 Cr for FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
